## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl who possesses a pointed face, delicate features, and a slim, milk-white throat. Her facial features include luminous, starry gray eyes alongside a nose with seven distinct freckles, which are fewer than she previously had, and cheeks that display pale, everchanging roses. She has a ruddy, red hair color that has been described as auburn or splendid [Titian](../character/titian.md), styled at times in long braids, smooth ripples, unbraided streaming strands, or shingled closely as short green hair. Over time, her thin figure and ungracefully long legs have grown tall enough to surpass [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in height.

## Personality

A deeply imaginative individual whose mind often drifts into remote cloudlands, she considers excessive dreaming to be a personal flaw that leads her to forget her duties. Her ambition is driven by a desire to be loved by everyone, to bring joy to others, and to add beauty to life, which inspires her to establish an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Highly motivated academically, she aspires to become a teacher, aims to pass her examinations near the top of the list to make [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) proud, and resolves to work hard to win the Avery scholarship in order to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Despite her loftier aspirations, she retains a specific fear of passing through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after dark.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P20](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XX. ## History

Anne Shirley was born an orphan in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), and spent a lonely childhood being shifted between overworked families to care for children before living in an asylum for four months. She was eventually adopted out of the asylum by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) was initially shocked because they had requested a boy. Despite early missteps, including a passionate outburst at neighbor [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and an accidental intoxication of her new friend [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), Anne quickly won over the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) and was permitted to stay. In school, after a classmate named [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teased her red hair by calling her 'Carrots,' Anne smashed a slate over his head, sparking a fierce academic rivalry and personal feud that lasted for years. Her childhood was marked by intense imaginations and dramatic misadventures, such as accidentally dying her hair green, getting trapped on a leaking boat while re-enacting a poem, and accidentally serving anodyne liniment cake to the minister's wife. Over time, her devotion to her studies under her teacher Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) paid off when she tied with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for first place on the island's entrance exams to Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). After graduating from Queen's with the prestigious Avery scholarship, tragedy struck when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died of sudden heart failure following a bank collapse. To keep [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) from losing her home and failing eyesight, Anne selflessly gave up her college scholarship to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher, prompting [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to give up his teaching post in town so she could take it; this act of kindness finally broke their feud and formed a deep friendship between them. Over her two years of teaching in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Anne co-founded the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), helped [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) raise the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and inadvertently sold her neighbor Mr. Harrison's cow by mistake. She also formed a cherished friendship with Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), ultimately helping reunite Miss Lavendar with her long-lost love, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). When [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) moved into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following her husband's death, Marilla's home and sight were secured, allowing Anne to resign her teaching post to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) alongside her childhood friends.

## Quotes

> "You would cry, too, if you were an orphan and had come to a place you thought was going to be home and found that they didn’t want you because you weren’t a boy. Oh, this is the most tragical thing that ever happened to me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011)

> "but, oh, please do call me Cordelia. It can’t matter much to you what you call me if I’m only going to be here a little while, can it? And Anne is such an unromantic name."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)

> "why didn’t you tell me at the station that you didn’t want me and leave me there? If I hadn’t seen the White Way of Delight and the Lake of Shining Waters it wouldn’t be so hard."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0025)

> "She brought Lily Jones for herself. Lily is only five years old and she is very beautiful and had nut-brown hair. If I was very beautiful and had nut-brown hair would you keep me?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029)

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Anne quickly formed a close bond with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) upon her arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), regarding her as a beloved friend and confidante. Their relationship began on a warm, supportive note when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) gently comforted Anne following a disastrous tea party at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where Anne accidentally flavored a layer cake with liniment. Over time, Anne has shared intimate afternoons at the manse with her, taking comfort in her kindness and guidance.

- Friend of — minister's wife and confidante  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's closest companion and self-described bosom friend, having solemnized their friendship with a vow in the garden shortly after meeting. Their bond weathered a severe test when Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) temporarily forbade them from playing together after an accidental incident with currant wine, though they secretly maintained contact until Anne saved Diana's sister from croup. They remain devoted friends who share imaginative adventures, school rivalries, and community projects together.

- Friend of — dearest friend and bosom friend  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. ### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) began as bitter academic rivals after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) mocked her red hair, prompting Anne to smash a slate over his head and refuse his apologies for years. Their fierce schoolroom competition eventually softened into mutual respect as they tied for first place on the island examinations and attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) together. By the time they returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as teachers, their past grudge had transformed into a close, collaborative friendship.

### [Katie Maurice](../character/katie-maurice.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--katie-maurice.md)

[Katie Maurice](../character/katie-maurice.md) was Anne's imaginary playmate and cherished confidante prior to her arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Anne used to speak to her reflection in a bookcase door, treating the imaginary girl as a bosom friend to cope with her lonely childhood before meeting real friends like [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
